raw_response:
Ayah, let me think about this year's planting.

I've been doing wheat-maize on this land for 40 years — same as my father before me. 10.1 mu isn't much, but with seven mouths to feed, every jin of grain matters. My sons help with the heavy work now; my back isn't what it was. Seven people in the house means I don't need to hire anyone — the family gets it done.

**Wheat (winter, going in this October):**

I already finished the wheat this past June, got about 420 kg/mu — not bad. For the next wheat crop I'll do what I always do. Buy one bag of compound fertilizer per mu (that 15-15-15 stuff, 50 kg bag) and spread it before plowing. Then at green-up in spring when the wheat looks a bit yellow, I topdress with urea — about half a bag per mu, maybe 20 kg. My neighbor old Wang uses more but he has better land near the canal. I use seed I save from last year's good field — saves money. Plant around October 10-15, when the weather cools.

Water: winter watering before freeze, then green-up in March, then at jointing, then at heading if it's dry. Usually 3-4 times. The well water costs money to pump, so I don't waste it.

**Maize (summer, planting now in June):**

Just finishing wheat harvest, need to get the maize in fast — within the week, or it won't mature before frost. I buy hybrid seed from the agro-shop in town, Zhengdan or whatever everyone's using this year, about 30 yuan per mu worth. No time to plow properly — I do no-till planting with the rented seeder, drop the seed right into the wheat stubble. That's what everyone does now.

Base fertilizer: one bag compound per mu again, goes in with the seeder. At big-flare stage (around late July), topdress urea, about 15-20 kg/mu. If it rains enough I won't irrigate, but if July-August is dry I'll water once or twice. Last year I got about 480 kg/mu, hope for similar.

Pesticide: spray herbicide once after planting for grassy weeds. If armyworms show up I'll spray, otherwise no.

Total for the year I figure maybe 350 yuan per mu in inputs, so about 3,500 yuan for the whole 10.1 mu. That's manageable.
